lines.beaver: 오늘 나들이 어디로 갈까? 날씨 좋다.
lines.beaver_en: Where should we go on our outing today? The weather's nice.
lines.beaver_roman: oneul nadeuri eodiro galkka? nalssi jota.
lines.learner: 낚시터 어때? 지난주에 거기서 큰 붕어를 낚았어.
lines.en: How about the fishing spot? I caught a big carp there last week.
lines.roman: naksiteo eottae? jinanjue geogiseo keun bungeoreul nakkasseo.

lines.beaver: 우와, 대단하다! 요즘 취미 생활 열심히 하네.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, amazing! You're really into your hobbies lately.
lines.beaver_roman: uwa, daedanhada! yojeum chwimi saenghwal yeolsimhi hane.
lines.learner: 응, 레저 활동을 하면서 스트레스를 풀어.
lines.en: Yeah, I relieve stress while doing leisure activities.
lines.roman: eung, rejeo hwaldongeul hamyeonseo seuteureseureul pureo.

lines.beaver: 낚시만 해? 취미에 대해 더 말해 줄래?
lines.beaver_en: Just fishing? Can you tell me more about your hobbies?
lines.beaver_roman: naksiman hae? chwimie daehae deo malhae jullae?
lines.learner: 등반도 하고 사진도 찍어. 찰칵 소리가 좋아.
lines.en: I go climbing and take photos too. I love the click sound.
lines.roman: deungbando hago sajindo jjigeo. chalkak soriga joa.

lines.beaver: 사진은 어디에 쓰는데? 그냥 모아 두는 거야?
lines.beaver_en: What do you use the photos for? Do you just keep them?
lines.beaver_roman: sajineun eodie sseuneunde? geunyang moa duneun geoya?
lines.learner: 아니, 사진을 넣어서 수필을 썼어. 곧 출간돼!
lines.en: No, I wrote essays with the photos. They're getting published soon!
lines.roman: ani, sajineul neoeoseo supireul sseosseo. got chulgandwae!

lines.beaver_en: Really? A book is coming out? Which publisher?
lines.learner: 작은 출판사인데, 내 글을 좋게 봐 줬어.
lines.en: It's a small publisher, but they liked my writing.
lines.roman: jageun chulpansainde, nae geureul joke bwa jwosseo.

lines.beaver: 축하해! 글 쓰는 거 어렵지 않았어?
lines.beaver_roman: chukahae! geul sseuneun geo eoryeopji anasseo?
lines.learner: 매일 시를 읊으면서 글 감각을 키웠어.
lines.en: I built my feel for writing by reciting poems every day.
lines.roman: maeil sireul eulpeumyeonseo geul gamgageul kiwosseo.

lines.learner: 아니, 낭독 모임에 나가. 다 같이 소리 내어 읽어.
lines.en: No, I go to a reading-aloud group. We all read out loud together.
lines.roman: ani, nangdok moime naga. da gachi sori naeeo ilgeo.

lines.beaver: 너 정말 바쁘게 사는구나. 다른 취미는 없어?
lines.beaver_en: You really live a busy life. Any other hobbies?
lines.beaver_roman: neo jeongmal bappeuge saneunguna. dareun chwimineun eopseo?
lines.learner: 주말엔 당구도 쳐. 퀴즈 대회에도 나갔고.
lines.en: I play billiards on weekends. I also entered a quiz contest.
lines.roman: jumaren danggudo chyeo. kwijeu daehoeedo nagatgo.

lines.beaver: 나도 다음에 같이 할까? 오늘은 어디 가?
lines.beaver_en: Should I join you next time? Where are we going today?
lines.beaver_roman: nado daeume gachi halkka? oneureun eodi ga?
lines.en: Sure! Let's make today's outing the fishing spot.

lines.beaver: 좋아, 출발하자! 나도 큰 고기 낚아 볼래.
lines.beaver_en: Great, let's go! I want to catch a big fish too.
lines.beaver_roman: joa, chulbalhaja! nado keun gogi nakka bollae.
lines.learner: 내가 낚는 법 알려 줄게. 사진도 찰칵!
lines.en: I'll show you how to catch one. And snap a photo, click!
lines.roman: naega nangneun beop allyeo julge. sajindo chalkak!
